visualReview.notes: Inspected all11 final portable views: whole ensemble from four sides, upper octagonal room and dome, courtyard, pavilion side, full mast and the new east Fatih doorway and timber wall walks. The restored court stays open; its recessed arched door and upper north entry stair remain visible. Courtyard walks have continuous decks and rails. The new timber stair is partly occluded by the perimeter wall in the whole-court camera; the focused geometry test checks its top tread joins the4.1m deck. The west pavilion facade is partly screened by its historic outer wall; it is not interpreted as missing geometry.

limitations: The modeled exterior follows the cited published facts and inspected photographs. Unpublished dimensions and local fittings are explicitly photo-proportioned; no claim of engineering survey accuracy is made.
Portable PBR and shared metric surfaces are provided. Surface weathering, material color under local lighting and fine facade relief require close render review before maximum-detail acceptance.
